purpose: Generate consistent UI sections and assemble a single full-length homepage design
prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a flat actual iPhone APP SCREEN CONTENT fragment for 多多打卡, ready for vertical stitching into a continuous long design. No phone device, no external background, no outer canvas gutter, no perspective, no board title. The screenshot content extends edge-to-edge of image. Solid pale #F3F4FA page surface.
Reference1 LEFT phone 首页·双列 is the authoritative individual card design: TITLE and gold STAR+POINTS on top row; large centered illustration on second row; time on separate third row; full inner-width button on last row. Do not use the right phone single column. Reference2 supplies ONLY colorful dome/telescope space station group decorations.
All task tiles are exactly the same TALL VERTICAL shape, aspect width:height about 0.83 (e.g.169pt wide by204pt high), not landscape cards. Use 390pt phone logical width. Page margin12pt, card section width366pt, padding8pt, two169pt columns with12pt gap. ROW GAP18pt plainly visible. NO plus buttons or placeholder frames in empty cells. Odd final card sits left, blank right.
Buttons FULL WIDTH of each card with at least40pt conceptual height, on a separate bottom row, NEVER beside illustration or beside timer. Card title clearly readable native Chinese semibold17pt. Time blue13pt. All art cute soft clay from references, not new brands. Completed state has mint tinted surface, mint semi-transparent circular approval stamp top right, green check and 已完成 text on bottom row WITHOUT a colored button. Keep enough height to separate picture, timer and button. Space-base decorative header 64pt tall, title on colored ribbon, count pill right. Header buildings stay out of cards.
No all-page illustrated sky or clouds; decorative clouds only inside header illustrations, hero or journey. Do not invent text or controls. Leave exactly24pt solid #F3F4FA padding at top/bottom where no nav specified. Every listed task must appear once.
FRAGMENT A, top part of the long page. Portrait, approximately1024x2900. Include native iOS status bar9:41 and navigation 多多打卡 at top, info left/shield right. NO TAB BAR, NO home indicator: page continues below.
Top hero COPY Reference1 LEFT phone exactly: left 今天也要 / 闪闪发光！, progress6/13 and 再得7分，飞船就能出发啦！; right panda astronaut/rocket; illustration confined in rounded hero. Native strip below:7今日自评,6有效打卡,0奖励分,家长确认.

Below24pt gap include COMPLETE energy group, orange#FF8D28 rounded outline and pale cream inner surface, orange utensil dome left and tinyrover right from reference2 header. 能量补给站 2/5.
Two columns / THREE ROWS of TALL cards,18pt row gaps:
row1 起床 ★+1 sun+bed,blue timer07:12,已完成+stamp | 吃早饭 ★+1 bowl+toast+milk,blue timer25:11/30,已完成+stamp.

The height must accommodate hero/journey AND 3 normal-height card rows. DO NOT squeeze the energy cards. This part ends with closed bottom orange group border then24pt solid page surface. No other groups, no footer,no tab.
